readme: Ten permissively licensed OSS libraries identified; core MapLibre and Leaflet code is locally bundled on Vercel. Remote tile/data services are NOT unlimited by virtue of OSS licenses. OpenFreeMap publicly states unlimited map views but no SLA; OSM official raster tiles permit only compliant fair use.

libraries.name: MapLibre GL JS
libraries.role: Self-hosted Vite-bundled v6 renderer with explicit locally bundled Web Worker; 5 no-key OpenFreeMap styles

libraries.name: Leaflet
libraries.role: Self-hosted 2D map renderer when WebGL or OpenFreeMap vector styles fail; OSM public raster tiles are limited-use

libraries.name: maplibre-gl-splat
libraries.role: Georeferenced raw Gaussian splat scene adapter, lazy-loaded

libraries.name: Spark
libraries.role: WebGL Gaussian splat renderer used by maplibre-gl-splat

libraries.name: Three.js
libraries.role: Scene graph / rendering used by maplibre-gl-splat

libraries.name: PMTiles
libraries.role: Optional self-hosted vector tile archives; no external CDN import on main map
